0022600002.text: The 76ers open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Knicks, who have also not played a 2026-27 game yet. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles) and has Adem Bona, Anfernee Simons, Dean Wade, and VJ Edgecombe listed as day-to-day and possible game-time decisions, while New York's Josh Hart is day-to-day with ankle soreness. The teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, but the 76ers lost their 2025-26 playoff series 0-4 and their most recent meeting 144-114 in Philadelphia on May 10, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Philadelphia a 45% chance to win.
